interventions.what: the recorder's watcher sent the host key F12+S directly to the game window (xdotool key --window, never a global keystroke) every ~20 s of the sitting; DOSBox-X wrote state.sav and the watcher staged a copy per snapshot (a savestate written; neutrality not tested)
each staged savestate's Vga and Memory components read (text screen and guest memory), as the G1 driver reads savestates (F001 route A)

the recorder copied a saved game into the session's game copy before DOSBox-X started: game/1.GL (169553 bytes, sha256 4a0f9bc0afaf0f32adf830de427a25120d60cacaf427922a630a86b50f86a470, newest .GL of the previous sessions); the owner loaded it with the game's own keys
